selection.group_bucket_rule: first 8 bytes big-endian SHA256(seed + NUL + group + NUL + repository_group) modulo 5; bucket 0 calibration, others eval
selection.task_rank: SHA256(seed + NUL + task + NUL + instance_id), then instance_id
selection.selection_input: allowlisted metadata only; no patch, test_patch, hints or dataset content

W-only: one W repair if visible gate fails
E-only: one E repair if visible gate fails
W-to-E: one fresh E takeover if visible gate fails

visible_gate.pass: candidate exists, permitted scope, baseline-valid frozen public checks all exit 0 before timeout
visible_gate.route: Only after infrastructure/telemetry/scope/snapshot/baseline preconditions pass and frozen public checks complete: candidate missing OR at least one public regression versus base; maximum one repair/takeover with exact visible evidence. A public-check timeout is unresolved, not a routing signal.
visible_gate.infrastructure: baseline broken, harness failure, telemetry loss, unsafe scope or unreconciled interrupted process => stop, no model escalation

acceptance.grader: independent hidden FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS on immutable candidate

stop: all unresolved gates block execution; after calibration require explicit review before eval; this preparation ends without polling or new trials
